data.one_liner: Redux saga middleware for Dart and Flutter to manage side effects.
data.what_it_does: Helps manage application side effects like data fetching and asynchronous tasks using synchronous generator functions. Acts as a middleware for Redux to start, pause, and cancel tasks via normal actions.
use_when: You are using Redux in your Flutter or Dart application and need to manage complex side effects
You want to handle asynchronous flows cleanly using generator functions without callback hell
You need advanced concurrency control like debouncing, throttling, or taking latest actions
avoid_when: You are not using Redux in your project
You prefer simpler state management solutions like Provider or Riverpod
strengths: Separates side effects cleanly from UI and reducers
Advanced concurrency patterns built-in (race, parallel, cancellation)
weaknesses: Steep learning curve compared to basic async/await or thunks
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up the saga middleware and connecting it to your Redux store.
